purpose: B-lite full re-run of the dynamic replay after the demand-integrity correction
critical_note: A and B are TWO INDEPENDENT EXPERIMENTS, NOT a controlled distance-metric comparison. They differ simultaneously in distance metric, resource pool and coordinate basis. Never pool their samples, never compute a pooled effect size, never claim OSM routing is superior to Haversine.
frozen: archived E9 v3/v4/NET-E9 CSVs and STATUS_superseded.md
strategy set and evolutionary budget across both configs

common.seed_rule: scenario_seed(scenario_id, seed) = (int.from_bytes(scenario_id.encode(),'big') & 0xFFFFFFFF) XOR (seed & 0xFFFFFFFF); event rng uses scenario_seed XOR 0x9E3779B9
common.statistical_unit: run (scenario x seed x profile); events are NESTED and never treated as independent samples

A.name: Legacy E9 (independent experiment)
A.distance_basis: straight-line Haversine over deterministic synthetic coordinates
A.resource_pool: official 47 crews + simulated inventory + 6 synthetic traffic-control teams

B.name: NET-E9 (independent experiment)
B.distance_basis: OSM shortest-path length from the precomputed routing matrix
B.resource_pool: 39 screened official crews (organisation-location proxies), synthetic traffic-control teams and simulated equipment excluded
B.coordinate_basis: official unit-coordinate proxies + synthetic route-relative incident endpoints
B.runtime_note: NetworkMatrixProvider reads data/spatial/resource_event_route_matrix.parquet; no geopandas call occurs on this path. This interpreter lacks geopandas, so a process-local empty-module shim is installed for the unrelated top-level imports in src/road_network/locator.py and route_matcher.py. Recorded in every manifest.

precheck.description: 28 scenarios x 4 profiles x 1 fixed seed = 112 runs per config; official optimiser budget; ONLY repetition count is reduced.

full.description: 28 scenarios x 4 profiles x 20 seeds = 2240 runs per config.
